requests.symptomDetails: Frequent watery stools and vomiting since 3 AM. Feeling very dehydrated, faint when standing up. Roommate attending class and left rehydration salts.

requests.symptomDetails: Started 2 days ago. Cough worsens at night. Throat is painful to swallow. Need checkup and excuse slip for missed Laboratory classes.

timeline.notes: Request submitted, waiting for health personnel assignment.

clinicalRecords.examinerTitle: Campus Health Nurse - Off-Site Response Team
clinicalRecords.symptomsObserved: Flushed face, warm to touch, mild conjunctival injection, non-exudative pharyngeal erythema, clear lungs bilaterally.
clinicalRecords.diagnosis: Acute Upper Respiratory Tract Infection (URTI) with High Febrile Episode
clinicalRecords.prescriptionAndCare:
1. Paracetamol 500mg tab: 1 tab PO every 4-6 hours for fever > 37.8°C.
2. Oral Rehydration Solution: 1 packet in 1 Liter clean water; drink frequently.
3. Cetirizine 10mg: 1 tab once daily at bedtime for 3 days.
4. Strict bed rest in well-ventilated boarding room; isolate temporarily from dorm mates.

excusedDuration.reason: Student is medically unfit for academic activities and physical attendance due to acute febrile viral illness.

clinicalRecords.remarks: Student evaluated on-site in boarding room. Vital signs stabilized after initial physical cooling and hydration. Dorm landlord notified to assist if fever spikes.
